description: Single source of truth for infrastructure-prefix error codes (GATEWAY_* / INTERNAL_*). See docs/development/backend.md §6.3.1 — that section is rendered from this file by scripts/generate-error-code-registry.py. Business-domain prefixes (AUTH_* / ANALYSIS_* / CONVERSATION_* / SEMANTIC_*) live in each service's OpenAPI details.errorCode enum and are NOT duplicated here.

GATEWAY_IDENTITY_MISSING.trigger: Protected route received a missing or malformed X-Auth-User-Id — gateway route mis-configured (gateway-auth not applied) or the request bypassed the gateway entirely.

GATEWAY_AUTH_REQUIRED.trigger: introspect returned active=false or the access_token cookie was missing / malformed on a route that requires authentication.

GATEWAY_CSRF_INVALID.trigger: Unsafe HTTP method missing X-Xsrf-Token header, or header value did not match the XSRF-TOKEN cookie (double-submit failure).
GATEWAY_CSRF_INVALID.retryGuidance: Fetch a fresh XSRF-TOKEN cookie (GET /api/v1/auth/csrf or any 2xx idempotent endpoint) and retry exactly once.

GATEWAY_INTROSPECT_UNAVAILABLE.trigger: introspect subrequest timed out, connection failed, or returned a non-2xx / malformed envelope. Collapses every upstream contract-violation onto this single code.

GATEWAY_NOT_READY.trigger: GET /gateway/ready aggregated at least one upstream whose /internal/ready probe returned non-200 or timed out.

INTERNAL_AUTH_FAILED.trigger: /api/internal/* path received a request whose X-Internal-Auth header was missing or did not match the shared secret. Deliberately 500 (not 401/403) because any occurrence signals gateway routing drift, not a user-facing auth failure.
